extentExamined: Main carina, both main bronchi, and segmental bronchi to subsegmental level bilaterally.
clinicalHistory: Persistent cough for 8 weeks, normal chest x-ray — diagnostic bronchoscopy to exclude endobronchial pathology.
findingsNarrative: Airways patent throughout with normal mucosa; no endobronchial lesion, compression, bleeding, foreign body, or purulent secretions.
samplesTaken: Bronchial washings sent for routine microbiology and cytology.
impression: Normal bronchoscopic examination; no endobronchial pathology identified.
recommendedFollowUp: No further respiratory follow-up required for this indication.
